title: Minnesota Fraud Research Money Record
description: First-class money record. Never sum overlapping dollars. amount billed ≠ amount paid ≠ amount stolen ≠ proven amount ≠ program spending ≠ identified-for-recovery ≠ recovered money ≠ restitution ordered ≠ restitution collected. A program-wide alleged-fraud estimate may already contain amounts charged in individual cases; those cases cannot be added to the program estimate. Never put a TOTAL FRAUD number on a homepage.

metricType.description: Dollar figures are not interchangeable. amount_billed ≠ amount_paid ≠ alleged_loss ≠ proven_loss ≠ restitution_ordered ≠ recovered_amount. Never collapse figures into a headline TOTAL FRAUD number. The circulating '$9 billion' Minnesota Medicaid figure is a fraud_estimate or investigative hypothesis, not proven_loss.

evidenceClass.description: Evidentiary class of the supporting record. An indictment is CHARGED_ALLEGED (what prosecutors alleged), not ADJUDICATED. An official source is not independently proven merely because it is official.

exactOrApproximate.description: Whether the amount is a precise figure from the source or an approximation/rounding.

grossOrNet.description: Whether the amount is gross or net of offsets, recoveries, or other adjustments.

relation.description: INCLUDED_IN: this amount is already inside other_money_id. OVERLAPS_WITH: partial unknown overlap. SUPERSEDES: this figure replaces other_money_id. PARTIAL_COMPONENT_OF: this is a component of a larger figure. MAY_OVERLAP: overlap suspected but not demonstrated. NON_OVERLAPPING: reviewers confirmed these may be considered separately.

money_id.description: Durable identifier. Never use a display name as a key.

amount.description: Numeric value. Distinct from claim.amounts[].value, which remains the claim-embedded field name.

payer_id.description: Entity that paid or was billed as payer.

recipient_id.description: Entity that received or claimed the funds.

overlap_group_id.description: Optional grouping key for amounts that must not be summed.

overlaps.description: Explicit overlap graph. Never sum overlapping dollars. Preferred field name: overlaps. Alias: overlap_relations. Items: {relation, other_money_id, notes}.

overlap_relations.description: Alias of overlaps. Same items: {relation, other_money_id, notes}.
